technical-summary: Patch validation evidence is no longer bound to code or digests. A record qualifies by patch id, record_digest integrity, required provenance shape, eligibility/activation/correctness, passing verdicts for every contract id the patch binds now (ids, not hashes), and architecture coverage. Patch subject/implementation digest, validation-tooling digest, contract hash, base_ref and base_revision differences are EvidenceCheck.notes (G4 PASS detail 'note: ...'), never disqualifiers. Removed: the build-only carried-forward status and carry_forward plumbing, digest lineage (patch/lineage.py and its records), and the promote-needs-current-pin rule; legacy grandfather matches by patch id. Pin-bump evidence phase stops only on real failures (EVIDENCE_GATE_FAILED). known_broken dispositions stay revision/digest bound (they record a failure). Skills and reference docs rewritten to the new policy.
user-summary-candidate: Patch evidence now survives code, digest and pin changes; a rerun is requested deliberately by demoting the patch, not forced by a changed hash.
